overview: Horik II of Denmark was a later ninth-century Danish ruler known mainly through Frankish and ecclesiastical sources, especially in connection with Ansgar. The profile is anchored by concrete turning points: 854 — Comes to power after Horik I; 850s — Deals with Christian mission activity; after 864 — Later reign becomes obscure.

He died in around 870, and his reign belongs to the wider story of Scandinavian state formation, Christianization, dynastic conflict, and northern Europe’s ties to England, the Baltic, and the Empire.

contentSections.title: Overview
paragraphs: Horik II of Denmark was a later ninth-century Danish ruler known mainly through Frankish and ecclesiastical sources, especially in connection with Ansgar. The profile is anchored by concrete turning points: 854 — Comes to power after Horik I; 850s — Deals with Christian mission activity; after 864 — Later reign becomes obscure.

He died in around 870, and his reign belongs to the wider story of Scandinavian state formation, Christianization, dynastic conflict, and northern Europe’s ties to England, the Baltic, and the Empire.

contentSections.title: Birth and early life
paragraphs: No reliable source identifies Horik II of Denmark's exact birthplace or childhood setting. Horik II of Denmark's family background is usually placed in Early Danish ruling house, but the early chronology should be read cautiously.

Horik II of Denmark's early life belonged to the medieval Scandinavian world, where kinship, sea routes, church contacts, assemblies, and armed followings shaped the opportunities available to a ruler.

contentSections.title: Character and Personality
paragraphs: Horik II succeeded to a Danish kingship shattered by the slaughter of nearly the entire royal family around 854, and he is among the most shadowy rulers in the archive. The Frankish sources note that he, too, dealt with the missionary Ansgar and at first acted against Christian activity before relenting and permitting it, which has left a faint impression of a ruler who could be persuaded and who tolerated the new religion under diplomatic pressure.

Beyond this almost nothing survives. His personality cannot be reconstructed from the few notices that mention him, and the honest position is that he is known as a name in a fragile dynastic sequence rather than as a man whose temperament can be described. What little the record allows points to accommodation rather than confrontation with Christian mission and Frankish influence.

contentSections.title: As early Danish ruler
paragraphs: Horik II ruled after the violent end of Horik I’s reign. His position was shaped by fragmented Danish power and by contacts with Frankish and ecclesiastical authorities.

As Early Danish ruler, King of the Danes, Horik II of Denmark had to turn dynastic claim into workable authority through alliances, military pressure, church support, and acceptance by regional elites.

contentSections.title: Death
paragraphs: Horik II disappears from the evidence after the later ninth-century mission context. His death date and circumstances are unknown, so the article preserves the uncertainty rather than inventing a precise end.

contentSections.title: Legacy
paragraphs: Horik II matters because he belongs to the fragile early phase of Danish royal history and the Christian mission to Scandinavia.
Later saga, saintly, or national traditions often amplified Horik II of Denmark's reputation, so the article separates near-contemporary evidence from later memory where possible.

timeline.title: Born
timeline.description: Birth date and place are not securely known.

timeline.title: Comes to power after Horik I
timeline.description: Horik II emerged after the internal conflict that killed Horik I and many rival members of the Danish royal family.

timeline.title: Deals with Christian mission activity
timeline.description: Horik II is remembered in connection with Ansgar’s mission, when Christian worship gained limited protection within a still largely non-Christian Danish world.

timeline.title: Later reign becomes obscure
timeline.description: After the missionary notices, Horik II fades from the sources, showing how fragmentary early Danish royal chronology remains.

timeline.title: Likely dead or displaced
timeline.description: By the 870s Horik II was probably dead or no longer ruling; the source record no longer presents him as an active Danish king.

timeline.title: Dies
